title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The integrated protection and basic needs programme in Bekkaa Valley in Lebanon is implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 4.1: The most vulnerable/marginalised women, men, girls and boys in the communities affected by crisis can meet their basic needs. Activities and outcome include Basic Assistance (MPCA/in kind) to target Syrian refugee and vulnerable Lebanese host community HHs in Bekaa based on MPCA assessment. So, the most vulnerable are utilising humanitarian assistance that is principled, timely, of high quality and in line with their needs and priorities. Programmes are in partnership with Nabad Association for Development and SAWA for development and aid. ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Improve access to more diversified nutritional diets and food and improve the nutritional status of a target population- Improve access to WASH and nutrition knowledge- ensure that women and girls benefit equally with men from the activity to compensate for past discrimination
